The image shows a single mango leaf with multiple dark spots. The spots are small, somewhat circular, and black or dark brown. Some of the spots appear irregular and have coalesced into larger, necrotic (dead) patches. This pattern of small, black, irregular spots that expand into larger dead areas aligns well with the description of Anthracnose. The other descriptions do not fit: it is not a superficial dark deposit (Sooty_Mould), nor is it dieback starting from the tip (Die_Back). Powdery_Mildew symptoms are not described, but typically involve a white, powdery fungus, which is not present here.
